BrochureContent.Content:
Welcome to this beautiful three-bedroom detached bungalow, ideally positioned just a short stroll from Kilmore Village and only minutes from the nearby beaches. Step inside through the front door into a welcoming central hallway. To the front, a bright living room features a feature fireplace, creating a cosy focal point. Just off this space is a fully fitted kitchen/dining area, complete with both eye- and waist-level units. The adjoining sunroom opens out to a sun-filled beautiful mature and spacious garden, ideal for relaxing or entertaining. The property also offers three generously proportioned bedrooms, all with fitted wardrobes, along with a fully tiled family bathroom, complete with WC, wash hand basin, and shower. Nestled in the peaceful setting of The Willows, Sarshill, this location offers an ideal blend of countryside tranquillity and everyday convenience. Approximately 19km from Wexford the area provides easy access to schools, shops, restaurants, and leisure amenities while maintaining a quiet rural atmosphere. Sarshill is a well sought after residential area, popular with families and those seeking spacious surroundings and a relaxed pace of life, all within easy reach of nearby villages, beaches and town conveniences. The property is ideally positioned close to the coast, with the beautiful beaches around Kilmore Quay offering sandy stretches, scenic coastal walks, and charming harbour views, while Rosslare Strand is also just a short drive away. Dublin is easily accessible in approximately 2 hours by car, making the location suitable for commuters or occasional city travel. Overall, The Willows at Sarshill offers a superb lifestyle opportunity, combining peaceful rural living with excellent access to Wexford Town, coastline, and national transport routes.

VIEWING HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
